text: The book cover and spine above and the images which follow were not part of the original Ormsby translation—they are taken from the 1880 edition of J.
zh: 上面的书的封面和书脊以及后面的图像并非奥姆斯比原始译本的一部分，而是取自 1880 年版的 J.
chunks: The book cover and spine
above and the images
which follow were not part
of the original Ormsby translation— they are taken
from the 1880 edition of J.

text: His warmest admirers must admit that he is not a satisfactory representative of Cervantes.
chunks: His warmest admirers must admit
that he is not a satisfactory representative of Cervantes.

text: His “Quixote” is not so much a translation as a travesty, and a travesty that for coarseness, vulgarity, and buffoonery is almost unexampled even in the literature of that day.
zh: 他的《堂吉诃德》与其说是翻译，不如说是嘲讽，而这种嘲讽的粗俗、粗俗和滑稽甚至在当时的文学中也几乎是史无前例的。
chunks: His “Quixote” is not so much a translation
as a travesty, and a travesty
that for coarseness, vulgarity,
and buffoonery is almost unexampled even
in the literature of that day.

text: It is true that in a few difficult or obscure passages he has followed Shelton, and gone astray with him; but for one case of this sort, there are fifty where he is right and Shelton wrong.
zh: 确实，在一些困难或晦涩的段落中，他追随了谢尔顿，并与他一起误入歧途。但对于此类案件，有五十个他是对的而谢尔顿是错的。
chunks: It is true that in a few difficult
or obscure passages he has followed Shelton,
and gone astray with him; but for one case
of this sort, there are fifty
where he is right and Shelton wrong.

text: Cervantes won the ear of the Spanish people ought, mutatis mutandis, to be equally effective with the great majority of English readers.
zh: 塞万提斯赢得了西班牙人民的喜爱，经过必要的修改，对绝大多数英国读者也同样有效。
chunks: Cervantes won the ear
of the Spanish people ought,
mutatis mutandis, to be equally effective
with the great majority
of English readers.

text: All traces of the personality of Cervantes had by that time disappeared.
zh: 到那时，塞万提斯人格的所有痕迹都消失了。
chunks: All traces
of the personality of Cervantes had by that time disappeared.

text: Alfonso Munio, who, as territorial or local surnames were then coming into vogue in place of the simple patronymic, took the additional name of Cervatos.
zh: 阿方索·穆尼奥（Alfonso Munio）后来作为领土或地方姓氏取代简单的父名而流行起来，并取了另一个名字塞瓦托斯（Cervatos）。
chunks: Alfonso Munio, who, as territorial
or local surnames were then coming
into vogue in place
of the simple patronymic,
took the additional name of Cervatos.

text: Maria Mayor on the 9th of October, 1547.
zh: 玛丽亚市长，1547 年 10 月 9 日。
chunks: Maria Mayor
on the 9th
of October, 1547.

text: It was then a busy, populous university town, something more than the enterprising rival of Salamanca, and altogether a very different place from the melancholy, silent, deserted Alcalá the traveller sees now as he goes from Madrid to Saragossa.
chunks: It was then a busy, populous university town, something more
than the enterprising rival of Salamanca,
and altogether a very different place from the melancholy, silent,
deserted Alcalá the traveller sees now
as he goes from Madrid to Saragossa.

text: Porte, and to the victory of the combined fleets at Lepanto, belong rather to the history of Europe than to the life of Cervantes.
zh: 波特以及勒班陀联合舰队的胜利，更多地属于欧洲的历史，而不是塞万提斯的一生。
chunks: Porte, and to the victory
of the combined fleets
at Lepanto, belong rather
to the history of Europe
than to the life of Cervantes.

text: How he, a captive himself, contrived to do all this, is one of the mysteries of the story.
zh: 作为一名俘虏，他是如何设法做到这一切的，是这个故事的谜团之一。
chunks: How he, a captive himself,
contrived to do all this,
is one
of the mysteries
of the story.

text: Juan Blanco de Paz, an ecclesiastic and a compatriot, informed the Dey of the plot.
zh: 教士兼同胞胡安·布兰科·德巴斯向议会通报了这一阴谋。
chunks: Juan Blanco de Paz,
an ecclesiastic
and a compatriot,
informed the Dey
of the plot.

text: Palacios Salazar y Vozmediano, a lady of Esquivias near Madrid, and apparently a friend of the family, who brought him a fortune which may possibly have served to keep the wolf from the door, but if so, that was all.
zh: 帕拉西奥斯·萨拉查·沃兹梅迪亚诺 (Palacios Salazar y Vozmediano) 是马德里附近埃斯基维亚斯 (Esquivias) 的一位女士，显然是这家人的朋友，她给他带来了一大笔财富，这可能有助于防止狼入门，但如果是这样，那就仅此而已了。
chunks: Palacios Salazar y Vozmediano, a lady of Esquivias near Madrid,
and apparently a friend of the family,
who brought him a fortune
which may possibly have served to keep the wolf
from the door, but if so, that was all.

text: In order to remit the money he had collected more conveniently to the treasury, he entrusted it to a merchant, who failed and absconded; and as the bankrupt’s assets were insufficient to cover the whole, he was sent to prison at Seville in September 1597.
chunks: In order to remit the money he had collected more conveniently
to the treasury, he entrusted it to a merchant, who failed and absconded;
and as the bankrupt’s assets were insufficient
to cover the whole, he was sent
to prison at Seville in September 1597.

text: Men of wit, taste, and discrimination among the aristocracy gave it a hearty welcome, but the aristocracy in general were not likely to relish a book that turned their favourite reading into ridicule and laughed at so many of their favourite ideas.
chunks: Men of wit, taste, and discrimination
among the aristocracy gave it a hearty welcome,
but the aristocracy in general were not likely
to relish a book that turned their favourite reading
into ridicule and laughed at so many of their favourite ideas.

text: Don Quixote, he set to work to write more of these “Novelas Exemplares” as he afterwards called them, with a view to making a book of them.
zh: 堂吉诃德，他开始写更多这样的“中篇小说范例”，他后来将它们称为“中篇小说范例”，以期将它们写成一本书。
chunks: Don Quixote, he set
to work to write more
of these “Novelas Exemplares”
as he afterwards called them, with a view
to making a book of them.

text: Never was great work so neglected by its author.
zh: 伟大的作品从来没有像现在这样被作者如此忽视过。
chunks: Never was great work
so neglected by its author.

text: Had Avellaneda, in fact, been content with merely bringing out a continuation to “Don Quixote,” Cervantes would have had no reasonable grievance.
zh: 事实上，如果阿维拉内达仅仅满足于推出《堂吉诃德》的续集，塞万提斯就不会有任何合理的不满。
chunks: Had Avellaneda, in fact,
been content with merely bringing
out a continuation
to “Don Quixote,
” Cervantes would have had no reasonable grievance.

text: It is plain that he had at one time an intention of dealing with the pastoral romances as he had dealt with the books of chivalry, and but for Avellaneda he would have tried to carry it out.
zh: 显然，他曾经想像处理骑士书籍一样处理田园浪漫史，如果没有阿韦拉内达，他会尝试将其付诸实践。
chunks: It is plain that he had at one time an intention
of dealing with the pastoral romances
as he had dealt with the books
of chivalry, and but for Avellaneda he would have tried
to carry it out.

text: He who could take Cervantes’ distresses together with his apparatus for enduring them would not make so bad a bargain, perhaps, as far as happiness in life is concerned.
zh: 就生活的幸福而言，如果一个人能够接受塞万提斯的痛苦，并用他的手段来忍受这些痛苦，那么他也许不会做出如此糟糕的交易。
chunks: He who could take Cervantes’ distresses together
with his apparatus
for enduring them would not make
so bad a bargain, perhaps,
as far as happiness in life is concerned.

text: Cortés, a fair work of art no doubt, and unexceptionable had it been set up to the local poet in the market-place of some provincial town, is not worthy of Cervantes or of Madrid.
zh: 《科尔特斯》无疑是一件精美的艺术品，如果它是在某个外省城镇的市场上为当地诗人创作的，那也无可厚非，它配不上塞万提斯或马德里。
chunks: Cortés, a fair work of art no doubt,
and unexceptionable had it been set up
to the local poet in the market-place
of some provincial town,
is not worthy of Cervantes or of Madrid.

text: One explanation, no doubt, is that of all the books in the world, “Don Quixote” is the most catholic.
zh: 毫无疑问，一种解释是，在世界上所有的书籍中，《堂吉诃德》是最天主教的。
chunks: One explanation, no doubt,
is that
of all the books
in the world,
“Don Quixote” is the most catholic.

text: One theory was that the book was a kind of allegory, setting forth the eternal struggle between the ideal and the real, between the spirit of poetry and the spirit of prose; and perhaps German philosophy never evolved a more ungainly or unlikely camel out of the depths of its inner consciousness.
chunks: One theory was that the book was a kind
of allegory, setting forth the eternal struggle between the ideal and the real,
between the spirit of poetry and the spirit of prose;
and perhaps German philosophy never evolved a more ungainly
or unlikely camel out of the depths of its inner consciousness.

text: Spain’s chivalry had been dead for more than a century.
zh: 西班牙的骑士精神已经消亡一个多世纪了。
chunks: Spain’s chivalry had been dead
for more than a century.

text: Him we owe to the landlord’s chance remark in Chapter III that knights seldom travelled without squires.
zh: 我们要感谢房东在第三章中偶然提到的一句话：骑士很少在没有扈从的情况下出行。
chunks: Him we owe
to the landlord’s chance remark in Chapter III that knights seldom travelled without squires.

text: To himself, too, his creations had become realities, and he had become proud of them, especially of Sancho.
zh: 对他自己来说，他的创造也已成为现实，他为它们感到自豪，尤其是桑乔。
chunks: To himself, too,
his creations had become realities,
and he had become proud
of them,
especially of Sancho.

text: But Cervantes was too true an artist to spoil his work in this way.
zh: 但塞万提斯是一位真正的艺术家，不会以这种方式破坏他的作品。
chunks: But Cervantes was too true an artist
to spoil his work in this way.

text: One of the great merits of “Don Quixote,” and one of the qualities that have secured its acceptance by all classes of readers and made it the most cosmopolitan of books, is its simplicity.
zh: 《堂吉诃德》的一大优点，也是它被各阶层读者接受并使其成为最具世界性的书籍的品质之一，就是它的简单性。
chunks: One of the great merits of “Don Quixote, ” and one
of the qualities that have secured its acceptance
by all classes of readers
and made it the most cosmopolitan
of books, is its simplicity.

text: But even when better informed they seem to have no apprehension of the full force of the discrepancy.
zh: 但即使他们了解更多信息，他们似乎也没有意识到这种差异的全部影响力。
chunks: But even
when better informed they seem to have no apprehension of the full force of the discrepancy.

text: It is true that to do full justice to Spanish humour in any other language is well-nigh an impossibility.
zh: 确实，用任何其他语言来充分展现西班牙幽默几乎是不可能的。
chunks: It is true
that to do full justice
to Spanish humour
in any other language is well-nigh an impossibility.

text: Montesinos, all live and move and have their being; and it is characteristic of the broad humanity of Cervantes that there is not a hateful one among them all.
zh: Montesinos，万物皆有生命、活动、存在；塞万提斯博大的人性的特点是，他们之中没有一个可恨的人。
chunks: Montesinos, all live and move
and have their being; and it is characteristic
of the broad humanity of Cervantes
that there is not a hateful one
among them all.

text: Also my book must do without sonnets at the beginning, at least sonnets whose authors are dukes, marquises, counts, bishops, ladies, or famous poets.
zh: 另外，我的书一开始就不能有十四行诗，至少是公爵、侯爵、伯爵、主教、女士或著名诗人的十四行诗。
chunks: Also my book must do
without sonnets at the beginning,
at least sonnets
whose authors are dukes, marquises, counts, bishops,
ladies, or famous poets.

text: Now let us come to those references to authors which other books have, and you want for yours.
zh: 现在让我们来看看其他书籍中已有的、您想要的对作者的引用。
chunks: Now let us come
to those references to authors
which other books have,
and you want
for yours.

text: Or is it Hannibal again?
zh: 或者又是汉尼拔？
chunks: Or is it
Hannibal again?

text: Oh, fairest Dulcinea, could it be!
zh: 哦，最美丽的杜尔西内亚，这可能是吧！
chunks: Oh,
fairest Dulcinea,
could it be!

text: My master gives me none; he’s much too mean.” _B_.
chunks: My master gives me none;
he’s much too mean.” _B_.

text: He had in his house a housekeeper past forty, a niece under twenty, and a lad for the field and market-place, who used to saddle the hack as well as handle the bill-hook.
zh: 他家里有一个四十多岁的管家，一个二十岁以下的侄女，还有一个在田野和市场上工作的小伙子，他们负责给马鞍和处理钩子。
chunks: He had in his house a housekeeper
past forty, a niece under twenty, and a lad
for the field and market-place, who used
to saddle the hack as well
as handle the bill-hook.

text: The first thing he did was to clean up some armour that had belonged to his great-grandfather, and had been for ages lying forgotten in a corner eaten with rust and covered with mildew.
zh: 他做的第一件事就是清理一些曾经属于他曾祖父的盔甲，这些盔甲多年来一直被遗忘在角落里，锈迹斑斑，长满霉斑。
chunks: The first thing he did was
to clean up some armour
that had belonged to his great-grandfather,
and had been for ages lying forgotten
in a corner eaten with rust and covered with mildew.

text: These reflections made him waver in his purpose, but his craze being stronger than any reasoning, he made up his mind to have himself dubbed a knight by the first one he came across, following the example of others in the same case, as he had read in the books that brought him to this pass.
chunks: These reflections made him waver in his purpose, but his craze being stronger than any reasoning,
he made up his mind to have himself dubbed a knight
by the first one he came across, following the example of others
in the same case, as he had read
in the books that brought him to this pass.

text: and if so, you may dismount and safely reckon upon any quantity of sleeplessness under this roof for a twelvemonth, not to say for a single night.
zh: 如果是这样，你可以下马并放心地估计在这个屋檐下十二个月内有多少失眠，更不用说一个晚上了。
chunks: and if so, you may dismount
and safely reckon
upon any quantity of sleeplessness
under this roof for a twelvemonth,
not to say for a single night.

text: From this spot I rise not, valiant knight, until your courtesy grants me the boon I seek, one that will redound to your praise and the benefit of the human race.
zh: 勇敢的骑士，我不会从这里起身，直到您的礼貌给予我我所寻求的恩惠，这将回报您的赞扬和人类的利益。
chunks: From this spot I rise not, valiant knight,
until your courtesy grants me the boon I seek,
one that will redound
to your praise and the benefit
of the human race.

text: Thus warned and menaced, the castellan forthwith brought out a book in which he used to enter the straw and barley he served out to the carriers, and, with a lad carrying a candle-end, and the two damsels already mentioned, he returned to where Don Quixote stood, and bade him kneel down.
chunks: Thus warned and menaced, the castellan forthwith brought out a book
in which he used to enter the straw
and barley he served out to the carriers, and,
with a lad carrying a candle-end, and the two damsels already mentioned,
he returned to where Don Quixote stood, and bade him kneel down.

text: He had gone but a few paces into the wood, when he saw a mare tied to an oak, and tied to another, and stripped from the waist upwards, a youth of about fifteen years of age, from whom the cries came.
zh: 他刚走进树林几步，就看到一匹母马被拴在一棵橡树上，又拴在另一匹橡树上，腰部以上都被剥光了，是一个十五岁左右的年轻人，哭声就是从他身上传出来的。
chunks: He had gone but a few paces
into the wood, when he saw a mare tied
to an oak, and tied to another, and stripped
from the waist upwards, a youth
of about fifteen years of age, from whom the cries came.

text: I do not refuse, brother Andres,” said the farmer, “be good enough to come along with me, and I swear by all the orders of knighthood there are in the world to pay you as I have agreed, real by real, and perfumed.
zh: 我不会拒绝，安德烈斯兄弟，”农夫说，“请愿意跟我一起去，我以世界上所有的骑士勋章发誓，会按照我同意的方式支付给你，真实的，真实的，芳香的。
chunks: I do not refuse, brother Andres,
” said the farmer, “be good enough to come along with me,
and I swear by all the orders
of knighthood there are in the world to pay you
as I have agreed, real by real, and perfumed.

text: There were six of them coming along under their sunshades, with four servants mounted, and three muleteers on foot.
zh: 他们六个人在遮阳伞下走过来，四个仆人骑马，三个骡夫步行。
chunks: There were six
of them coming along
under their sunshades,
with four servants mounted,
and three muleteers on foot.

text: My Uncle and liege lord!
chunks: My Uncle
and liege lord!

text: See there! plague on it!” cried the housekeeper at this: “did not my heart tell the truth as to which foot my master went lame of?
zh: 看到那里！瘟疫袭来！” ”管家听了大叫道：“我的主人哪只脚瘸了，我的心不是说实话吗？
chunks: See there! plague
on it!” cried the housekeeper at this:
“did not my heart tell the truth
as to
which foot my master went lame of?

text: for, as I have heard say, this was the first book of chivalry printed in Spain, and from this all the others derive their birth and origin; so it seems to me that we ought inexorably to condemn it to the flames as the founder of so vile a sect.
chunks: for, as I have heard say,
this was the first book of chivalry printed in Spain,
and from this all the others derive their birth
and origin; so it seems to me that we ought inexorably
to condemn it to the flames as the founder of so vile a sect.

text: They were handed to her, and as there were many of them, she spared herself the staircase, and flung them down out of the window.
zh: 他们把它们递给了她，由于数量很多，她省下了楼梯，把它们扔出了窗外。
chunks: They were handed to her,
and as there were many of them,
she spared herself the staircase,
and flung them down
out of the window.

text: and on that score we might have excused the Captain if he had not brought him into Spain and turned him into Castilian.
zh: 就这一点而言，如果上尉没有把他带到西班牙并把他变成卡斯蒂利亚人，我们可能会原谅他。
chunks: and on
that score we might have excused the Captain
if he had not brought him
into Spain and turned him
into Castilian.

text: Take it home with you and read it, and you will see that what I have said is true.
zh: 把它带回家读一读，你就会发现我说的是真的。
chunks: Take it home
with you
and read it,
and you will see
that what I have said is true.

text: If there were not so many of them,” said the curate, “they would be more relished: this book must be weeded and cleansed of certain vulgarities which it has with its excellences; let it be preserved because the author is a friend of mine, and out of respect for other more heroic and loftier works that he has written.
chunks: If there were not so many of them, ” said the curate, “they would be more relished:
this book must be weeded and cleansed of certain vulgarities
which it has with its excellences; let it be preserved
because the author is a friend of mine, and out of respect
for other more heroic and loftier works that he has written.

text: For the present let them bring me something to eat, for that, I feel, is what will be more to my purpose, and leave it to me to avenge myself.
zh: 现在就让他们给我带点吃的吧，因为我觉得这更符合我的目的，就让我自己去报仇吧。
chunks: For the present let them bring me something
to eat, for that, I feel,
is what will be more to my purpose,
and leave it to me
to avenge myself.

text: Meanwhile Don Quixote worked upon a farm labourer, a neighbour of his, an honest man (if indeed that title can be given to him who is poor), but with very little wit in his pate.
zh: 与此同时，唐吉诃德正在为一位农场工人工作，他是他的邻居，一个诚实的人（如果这个称号确实可以给予穷人的话），但他的头脑中没有什么智慧。
chunks: Meanwhile Don Quixote worked upon a farm labourer,
a neighbour of his, an honest man (if indeed
that title can be given
to him who is poor),
but with very little wit in his pate.

text: Señor Knight-errant, not to forget about the island you have promised me, for be it ever so big I’ll be equal to governing it.
zh: 游侠大人，别忘了你答应过我的那个岛，无论它有多大，我都可以统治它。
chunks: Señor Knight-errant, not to forget
about the island you have promised me,
for be it ever
so big I’ll be equal
to governing it.

text: A slight breeze at this moment sprang up, and the great sails began to move, seeing which Don Quixote exclaimed, “Though ye flourish more arms than the giant Briareus, ye have to reckon with me.
chunks: A slight breeze at this moment sprang up,
and the great sails began to move,
seeing which Don Quixote exclaimed,
“Though ye flourish more arms than the giant Briareus,
ye have to reckon with me.

text: Don Quixote did not care to break his fast, for, as has been already said, he confined himself to savoury recollections for nourishment.
zh: 堂吉诃德并不想开斋，因为正如前面所说，他只用回忆来补充营养。
chunks: Don Quixote did not care
to break his fast, for,
as has been already said,
he confined himself
to savoury recollections for nourishment.

text: The second brother, seeing how his comrade was treated, drove his heels into his castle of a mule and made off across the country faster than the wind.
zh: 二哥见同伴受了这样的待遇，便把脚后跟踩进了他的骡子城堡，风驰电掣般地穿越了全国。
chunks: The second brother,
seeing how his comrade was treated,
drove his heels into his castle
of a mule and made
off across the country faster than the wind.

text: This distressed me greatly, because the pleasure derived from having read such a small portion turned to vexation at the thought of the poor chance that presented itself of finding the large part that, so it seemed to me, was missing of such an interesting tale.
chunks: This distressed me greatly, because the pleasure derived
from having read such a small portion turned
to vexation at the thought of the poor chance that presented itself
of finding the large part that,
so it seemed to me, was missing of such an interesting tale.

text: In this I know will be found all that can be desired in the pleasantest, and if it be wanting in any good quality, I maintain it is the fault of its hound of an author and not the fault of the subject.
zh: 我知道，在这一点上，我们会发现最令人愉快的一切，如果它缺乏任何好的品质，我认为这是作者的猎犬的错，而不是主题的错。
chunks: In this I know will be found all
that can be desired in the pleasantest,
and if it be wanting in any good quality,
I maintain it is the fault of its hound of an author
and not the fault of the subject.

text: What vial and what balsam is that?” said Sancho Panza.
zh: 那是什么瓶子，是什么香脂？”桑乔·潘萨说道。
chunks: What vial
